source: Hypothetical design: a plausible design, not one blab runs. Settings are blab's standard runner settings; the onset rule is blab's own (it is used in blab's timeWrap experiment, where the FALL follows a rise-and-hold rule and is safe).

setparam.datapb: bundled babble mtbabble48k.wav, loaded with free-speech get_noiseSource (479,230 samples)

switching: OST loaded once; PCF reloaded before every trial (the shift PCF, or the zero PCF on catch trials); reset() before every trial
input: synthetic two-word trials: word 1 = /ae/-like vowel (F0 210 Hz, formants [731 2058 2979 4000] Hz), word 2 = /e/-like vowel 0.5 s (F0 200 Hz, formants [500 1500 2600 4000] Hz); 0.15 s silence before word 1, 0.25 s pause
playground_left_out: the masking noise: the Playground plays its own generated pink noise, not the lab's babble file
the trial sequence: the link loads one trial's settings; run several trials as one session in the Playground to see carry-over
